value.definition: a change composed by an agent

invariants.statement: An authored change is refused until its required reading is read.

value.definition: a change a program composed and the checks judge

invariants.statement: A checked change is composed by a program rather than by an agent.
No reading is owed for a change no agent composed.
A fault a checked change lands is a fault in the program that composed the change.
A check refusing a checked change refuses the whole act.
A program whose change the checks refuse is mended rather than exempted.

value.definition: a change composed by a program

invariants.statement: A mechanical change is not shown to Alan line by line.
A mechanical change is not authored prose.
A fault a mechanical change lands is a fault in the program that composed the change.
A fault the audit finds is repaired rather than undone.
A fault a mechanical change lands is found by the audit.

value.definition: a change saying what a page already said in other words

invariants.statement: A restated change owes the reading an authored change owes.
Every reading of a page a restatement changes answers for the page the restatement leaves.
A restated change is composed by an agent rather than by a program.
A restated change leaves a page's meaning unchanged.
Only the words a page states are changed.
A rewrite narrowing the claim a statement binds is authored rather than restated.
Every check an authored change is judged by judges a restated change.
A restated change moving more than the words a page states is refused.
